title: Transcript-ranked highlights for Shorts
what_it_does: Takes a punctuated word-timed transcript, ranks complete sentences (with optional keywords), merges them within a time budget, dedups near-repeats, and cuts accurately with ffmpeg. Keeps whole sentences so a clip never ends mid-thought.
when_to_use: Long video to one or several Shorts/Reels.
why: MIT, has tests, no API of its own; needs a transcript with sentence punctuation, which whisper.cpp or the ffmpeg-skill transcriber can produce.
